findings.detail: The extracted A07 percentage sum is 0.0%, but the SOI schedule total reports Total Investments at 151.36% of net assets.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate-style flag: the queue artifact reports pct_sum=0.0% with no detail rows, but the raw SOI total line has a populated % of Net Assets value of 151.36% for Total Investments. The source therefore supports a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
